scripts.text: I want to sign up too,
I'll be able to watch them become Dancers right before my eyes...!
scripts.translation: 席舞者！我能亲眼看着她们成为舞娘...！

scripts.text: a man in this day and age! Hurray for the Comodo Theater!
scripts.translation: 代，做个男人真好！克魔岛剧场万岁！

scripts.text: It's a good opportunity to watch the Dancer job change test.
scripts.translation: ？这可是观看舞娘转职考验的好机会。

scripts.text: Go to the Job Change Area
I'm sorry, but you're interrupting my practice by looking at me funny.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，你用那种奇怪的眼神看着我，打扰到我练习了。

scripts.text: That's weird, I can't remember where I've seen you.
scripts.translation: ..奇怪，想不起在哪儿见过你了。

scripts.text: if you have any new songs. We can always use some new music to complement our performances.
scripts.translation: 新歌的话，记得告诉我。我们的表演，总需要些新音乐来配合。

scripts.text: Hey, only authorized personnel can come here. Not just anyone can enter the Dance School.
scripts.translation: ？嘿，只有获准的人才能进来。舞蹈学校可不是谁都能进的。

scripts.text: If you want to watch, why don't you go to the Dance Stage in town?
scripts.translation: 想看表演，不如去镇上的舞台？

scripts.text: where we teach various dances from different countries. We provide entertainement for travelers from all over the world.
scripts.translation: 岛舞蹈学校”，教授各国的舞蹈，也为来自世界各地的旅人带来欢乐。

scripts.text: We also provide the opportunity for aspiring Dancers to become famous throughout the Rune-Midgarts Kingdom! Doesn't dancing in the spotlight sound spectacular?
scripts.translation: 我们也为胸怀梦想的舞娘提供机会，让她们名扬卢恩·米德加兹王国！在聚光灯下起舞，是不是很令人向往？

scripts.text: I think it's fair to let you know that our school is selective. So we don't accept students who don't seem to have the talent to become Dancers.
scripts.translation: 得先告诉你，我们招生是有筛选的。没有舞蹈天赋的学生，我们可不会收。

scripts.text: Do you want to sign up? You only have to write a couple of things on the application, and you can just come to the lessons once or twice and try it out.
scripts.translation: ，想报名吗？申请表只需填几项，先来上一两节课，试试看也行。

scripts.text: Just fill out the application right there.
Wow! What a pretty name! Just a moment, I have to show this to the director, so come back in a little bit, okay?
scripts.translation: ？哇，名字真好听！稍等，我得把申请表给总监看看，过会儿再来，好吗？

scripts.text: you aren't quite qualified to enroll in our school yet. You need to be at least Job Level 40.
scripts.translation: 还不符合入学条件。职业等级至少要达到40级。

scripts.text: Hey, this place is only for authorized personnel. If you want to sing, you should go look into being a Bard.
scripts.translation: 嗯？嘿，这里只有获准的人才能进来。想唱歌的话，不如考虑成为诗人。

scripts.text: At least, not without some sort of sex change~
scripts.translation: 为舞娘。至少得先变性才行~

scripts.text: Since you signed up earlier, I'll let you know some things you'll need to bring for your lessons.
scripts.translation: ，你之前已经报名了。现在说说，上课需要带些什么。

scripts.text: We're short on some supplies, but you'll be using them for yourself anyway. Just think of it as part of the tuition, so don't worry too much.
scripts.translation: 我们有些用品不够，不过，反正都是你自己要用的。就当学费的一部分，不必太担心。

scripts.text: First, there's the tuition fee of ^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000. Then, you'll about ^CD688920 Sticky Mucus^000000 for shoe polish.
scripts.translation: 首先，学费是10,000 Zeny。还需要20个粘稠液体，用来擦鞋。 ^CD6889^000000^CD6889^000000

scripts.text: Then, bring ^CD68893 Jellopy^000000 and ^CD68895 Red Potions^000000 to use as ointment. And of course, you'll need a pair of ^CD6889Shoes^000000.
scripts.translation: 再带3个杰勒比结晶和5个红色药水，用作药膏。当然，还得有一双长靴。 ^CD6889^000000^CD6889^000000^CD6889^000000

scripts.text: First, there's the tuition fee of ^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000. Then, bring ^CD68895 Earthworm Peelings^000000 for polishing the floor and, of course, a pair of ^CD6889Boots^000000.
scripts.translation: 首先，学费是10,000 Zeny。再带5个蚯蚓皮，用来擦地板。当然，还需要一双靴子。 ^CD6889^000000^CD6889^000000^CD6889^000000

scripts.text: First, there's the tuition fee of ^CD688910,000 Zeny^000000. Then, bring ^CD68892 Clam Shells^000000 for your costume, ^CD68895 Yellow Potions^000000 and ^CD688920 Jellopy^000000 to treat foot injuries.
scripts.translation: 首先，学费是10,000 Zeny。再带2个蛤蜊外壳，制作服装；以及5个黄色药水和20个杰勒比结晶，治疗脚伤。 ^CD6889^000000^CD6889^000000^CD6889^000000^CD6889^000000

scripts.text: You'll also need to bring ^CD688910 Black Hairs^000000 to make wigs for the performances and, of course, a pair of ^CD6889Sandals^000000. Once again, that's...
scripts.translation: 还需要10个长发，制作演出用的假发。当然，也得带一双轻便鞋。再说一遍，就是... ^CD6889^000000^CD6889^000000

scripts.text: Once you've gathered everything that you need, come back so that we can begin the lessons, okay?
scripts.translation: 东西备齐后，就回来开始上课，好吗？

scripts.text: Next, go to ^CD6889Bijou^000000, who is in charge of the interviewing process. She will have a couple of things she'll need to ask you.
scripts.translation: 接下来，去找负责面试的碧珠。她有几个问题要问你。 ^CD6889^000000

scripts.text: You need to talk to her because she's in charge of the interviewing process. Don't worry, she should be somewhere here in the Dance School.
scripts.translation: 她负责面试，你得去找她谈谈。别担心，她就在舞蹈学校里。

scripts.text: If you want to watch, be quiet and don't disturb the performers. Everyone here is busy practicing so that they can become fine Dancers.
scripts.translation: 想看的话，保持安静，不要打扰表演者。大家正忙着练习，努力成为优秀的舞娘。

scripts.text: Ooh, a Bard! Do you have any new songs to show us? We can always use some musical accompaniment for our dances.
scripts.translation: ~哦，是诗人！有新歌想唱给我们听吗？我们的舞蹈，总需要些音乐伴奏。

scripts.text: You seem to have traveled quite a distance to watch me perform.
scripts.translation: 看来你为了看我的表演，特地赶了很远的路呢。

scripts.text: I'm sorry, but I've retired. Now I'm focusing on training new Dancers. If you go to the Center Stage, you can watch my students~
scripts.translation: 抱歉，我已经退休了。现在专心培养新舞娘。去中央舞台就能看到我的学生表演哦~

scripts.text: I know you're excited, but the first step is the application. Go over to the left side of the stage where Aile can help you with that.
scripts.translation: 我知道你很兴奋，不过得先报名。去舞台左侧找艾尔，她会帮你办理手续。

scripts.text: Well, it's not much, so you'll lose it in no time. Especially since I'll be handling your training~
scripts.translation: 的赘肉！不过也不多，很快就能减掉的。何况还有我亲自指导你训练呢~

scripts.translation: 5. 在到达克魔岛之前，法老灯塔岛东北方向的地区叫什么？

scripts.text: is not a characteristic of a Dancer?
There aren't too many people who apply for the Dancer job with this kind of knowledge. I'm sorry for judging you by your looks~
scripts.translation: 来报名转职舞娘的人，像你这样知识丰富的可不多。抱歉，刚才以貌取人了~

scripts.text: Now you only have the Dance Test. While we prepare the test, why don't you rest a bit? Ho ho ho~
scripts.translation: 现在只剩舞蹈测试了。趁我们准备测试，你先休息一下吧？呵呵呵~

scripts.text: It wasn't perfect, but I'll let you pass.
scripts.translation: 让我看看...你的得分是分...非常棒！满分！
让我看看...你的得分是分...你...你没通过！

scripts.text: When I was young, everyone knew at least enough to pass this test. Go and study some more before coming back, okay?
scripts.translation: 我年轻的时候，这些都是人人都懂的知识，足够通过测试了。回去再好好学习一下再来，好吗？

scripts.text: First of all, each person gets ^CD68891 minute^000000 for the test, and everyone dances ^CD6889one at a time^000000. Don't worry if you've never danced before~
scripts.translation: 首先，每个人的测试时间是1分钟，而且每次只考一人。就算以前没跳过舞，也不用担心~ ^CD6889^000000^CD6889^000000

scripts.text: Once you enter the testing area, you will see the stage. First, ^CD6889change your camera angle so that it faces forward^000000. It will probably work if you ^CD6889double-click on the right mouse button^000000.
scripts.translation: 进入测试区域后，你会看到舞台。首先，调整视角，让镜头朝向正前方。一般双击鼠标右键就可以了。 ^CD6889^000000^CD6889^000000

scripts.text: If you don't reset your camera angle, you may get the ^CD6889Up, Down, Left, Right^000000 commands confused.
scripts.translation: 如果不重置视角，你可能会搞混上、下、左、右的指令。 ^CD6889^000000

scripts.text: Wait for your turn in the ^CD6889waiting room^000000. If the person in front of you fails, or if it's your turn in line, your test will begin.
scripts.translation: 请在候考室等候。前面的人测试失败，或是排到你时，你的测试就会开始。 ^CD6889^000000

scripts.text: If there are a lot of people, not everyone might fit in the waiting room. If that's the case, just create an orderly line~
scripts.translation: 人多的话，候考室可能容不下所有人。这时请大家有序排队~

scripts.text: When the test begins, the music will be broadcast, as well as the direction in which you should move. Just follow the instructions and move your legs.
scripts.translation: 测试开始后，会播放音乐，同时告诉你该往哪个方向移动。跟着指令迈步就行了。

scripts.text: Remember, ^CD6889you will be disqualified if you don't perform the steps with the right timing^000000. Be careful, the test is very strict~
scripts.translation: 记住，如果没有在正确的时机迈出舞步，就会被取消资格。要小心，测试的判定很严格哦~ ^CD6889^000000

scripts.text: Your performance shows that you are than qualified to become a Dancer. Well then, let me change your job.
scripts.translation: 你的表现证明，你完全有资格成为舞娘。那么，我来为你转职吧。

scripts.text: With the blessing of our goddess, you shall be reborn as a Dancer. From now on, no one will leave your presense without a smile~
scripts.translation: 在女神的祝福下，你将以舞娘的身份迎来新生。从今往后，所有人都会带着笑容离开你的身边~

scripts.text: May your performances always bring joy to your audience~
scripts.translation: 收下。愿你的表演总能为观众带来欢乐~
